content.title: Rosalía Joins ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 in Major Win for Exes Who Stay Friends
content.text: After what seems like eons, season three of Euphoria is finally in production, and has added some exciting new cast members to boot — including Spanish pop star Rosalía, who famously dated the show’s star Hunter Schafer in 2019.Deadline first reported the additions to the cast on Friday. In addition to Rosalía, Bottoms star (and ex-Super Bowl champ) Marshawn Lynch will also be joining the cast, as well as Kadeem Hardison (A Different World). Series regulars Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney, Hunter Schafer, and Jacob Elordi will also be returning.In a statement to Deadline, the “DESPECHÁ” singer said, “If there’s anything that excites me as much as finding a good melody or a good lyric, it’s becoming a better performer every day.” She added that the show “has been my favorite series of the last few years and I couldn’t be happier and more grateful to be acting alongside all these colleagues that I admire so much and contributing my ‘granito de arena’ to bring [series creator] Sam [Levinson]’s vision to reality.”Levinson has long spoken about his long-standing vision for the show’s third season despite numerous delays. In an August 2023 profile of Zendaya, the showrunner said that the third season of Euphoria would be a “film noir,” with Zendaya’s character Rue serving as an exploration of “what it means to be an individual with principles in a corrupt world.”It’s unclear, though, if that will still come to fruition, given a March 2024 report from Variety on creative conflicts between Levinson and the streamer. But at least one element of the plot is confirmed: the show will skip forward five years, taking the characters out of high school, per Deadline. Though HBO stated in November 2023 that the third season would premiere sometime in 2025, Deadline reported that the series will instead come out in 2026, four years after its last airing.Delays aside, the news of Rosalía’s casting will undoubtedly be exciting for a certain corner of the sapphic internet. Last April, Schafer confirmed to GQ that she and Rosalía dated for the second half of 2019 after years of fan speculation. Though the two only dated for five months, Schafer said that they were still friends and that the singer was “family no matter what.”And hey, just saying: Rosalía would be the perfect romantic interest for Schafer’s character, Jules — especially given how absent she was in season two.Get the best of what’s queer.
